name: Exp_BrainTrend2_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_MMRec
summary: This EA combines the BrainTrend2 signal indicator with the AbsolutelyNoLagLwma (a zero-lag linear weighted moving average) to generate trend-following trade entries. It incorporates money management with position sizing recommendations (MMRec) based on account equity and risk parameters. The system opens positions in the direction of the combined trend signals and manages them with stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA将BrainTrend2信号指标与AbsolutelyNoLagLwma（零滞后线性加权移动平均线）结合，生成趋势跟踪交易入场信号。它集成了基于账户权益和风险参数的资金管理仓位建议功能（MMRec）。系统根据综合趋势信号方向开仓，并通过止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于BrainTrend2指标和AbsolutelyNoLagLwma指标的双重趋势确认，BrainTrend2提供主趋势方向判断，AbsolutelyNoLagLwma作为零滞后移动平均线提供精确的趋势方向和动态支撑阻力。入场条件为两个指标同时发出同方向信号时开仓做多或做空，确保趋势一致性。出场条件包括达到预设止盈目标、触发止损保护或指标发出反向信号时平仓。仓位管理通过MMRec模块根据账户权益百分比和固定风险比例动态计算每手交易量，避免过度杠杆。资金管理方面，系统根据账户余额和风险容忍度自动调整仓位大小，在连续亏损时不会加倍仓位，属于非马丁格尔的保守资金管理方式。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual trend confirmation from the BrainTrend2 indicator and the AbsolutelyNoLagLwma indicator. BrainTrend2 provides the primary trend direction judgment, while AbsolutelyNoLagLwma serves as a zero-lag weighted moving average that offers precise trend direction and dynamic support/resistance levels. Entry conditions require both indicators to simultaneously signal the same direction before opening a long or short position, ensuring trend consistency and reducing false signals. Exit conditions include reaching the preset take-profit target, triggering the stop-loss protection, or closing when the indicators issue a reverse signal. Position sizing is dynamically calculated through the MMRec module based on account equity percentage and fixed risk ratio, preventing excessive leverage. Money management automatically adjusts lot size according to account balance and risk tolerance without employing martingale doubling after losses, representing a conservative non-martingale approach to capital allocation.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (when MM is disabled)

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理自动计算仓位
parameters.description_en: Enable money management for automatic lot calculation

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示使用指标计算
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示使用指标计算
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不使用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in points from current price

pros: 双指标确认机制有效减少假信号和频繁交易，提高入场质量
零滞后移动平均线减少了传统MA的延迟问题，使趋势判断更及时
内置资金管理模块根据风险比例自动调整仓位，避免过度交易和账户爆仓风险
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false signals and overtrading, improving entry quality
Zero-lag weighted moving average reduces the delay problem of traditional MAs, enabling more timely trend detection
Built-in money management module automatically adjusts position size based on risk ratio, preventing overtrading and account blow-up risk
cons: 双指标确认可能导致入场滞后，在快速反转行情中错过最佳入场时机
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损，缺乏震荡市场识别和过滤机制
参数较多且指标周期固定，缺乏自适应市场波动率调整能力
cons_en: Dual indicator confirmation may cause delayed entries, missing optimal entry points during rapid market reversals
Trend-following strategies are prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets, lacking a choppy market identification and filtering mechanism
Multiple parameters with fixed indicator periods lack adaptive adjustment capability for changing market volatility
improvements: 增加震荡市场识别过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在横盘行情中暂停交易以减少亏损
引入多周期确认机制，结合更高时间框架趋势方向过滤低质量信号
improvements_en: Add a ranging market identification filter (such as ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading during sideways markets and reduce losses
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, combining higher timeframe trend direction to filter low-quality signals

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能连续止损，造成资金回撤
缺乏最大回撤控制和每日亏损限额保护机制
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may incur consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets, causing significant drawdown
Lacks maximum drawdown control and daily loss limit protection mechanisms
